jobs.title: Global Process Owner - R2R
jobs.reason: This is a senior global finance process ownership role (Record-to-Report / Procure-to-Pay), entirely outside the candidate's field of international relations and law. It requires deep finance process expertise, ERP systems knowledge, and ideally ACCA/CIMA qualification, none of which the candidate holds, and the seniority level (owning $1.6B turnover processes, influencing 180 finance staff) is far beyond entry level.

jobs.title: Future Lead Auditor for ISO 13485
jobs.reason: This is a medical-device auditor role requiring a BSc in biomedical/life sciences and four years of medical device industry experience — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy field and skill set. Pure mismatch on field and specialist technical skills.

jobs.title: Working Student - Data & Polling (m/f/d)
jobs.reason: ECFR is a leading European foreign policy think tank — a direct fit with the candidate's core interests in IR and European policy. The data/polling focus aligns well with their quantitative skills (SPSS, Python, Excel), and the working-student format is exactly appropriate for their MSc-in-progress stage.

jobs.title: Assistant Accountant
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility triggered: the role requires part-qualification in AAT, CIMA, ACCA or equivalent accounting credentials, which the candidate does not hold. The position is also a pure finance/accounting role unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy field.

jobs.title: Campaigning, Senior Consultant
jobs.reason: This is a senior corporate communications/campaigning role requiring 6–9 years of experience, which is a hard ineligibility trigger for the candidate. The field (corporate PR for FTSE/Fortune clients) is also far from the candidate's IR/international law focus.

jobs.title: Associate Lecturer in Archaeology
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: the role requires a completed or near-completed PhD in Roman archaeology, which the candidate does not have. Field (Roman archaeology) and skills (subject-matter expertise, undergraduate teaching experience) are entirely outside the candidate's IR/international law profile.

jobs.title: Defence & Security Policy Fellow (m/f/d)
jobs.reason: Field alignment is excellent — European security/defence policy at a top pan-European think tank directly matches the candidate's forthcoming defence-policy publication and IR focus. However, the role explicitly requires a minimum of 5 years' experience in security/defence and EU-UK relations as a hard requirement, which the candidate (MSc in progress, student-assistant roles only) does not meet. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Embedded Intelligence Program Manager
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility on seniority: the role explicitly requires 5-7+ years of relevant experience plus 3-5 years of management experience, far beyond the candidate's student-assistant background. Although the geopolitical/intelligence field is adjacent to the candidate's interests, this is a senior program management position.

jobs.title: Food Safety Auditors - (Global)
jobs.reason: This is a food safety auditing contractor role requiring specialist sector qualifications and audit experience (retail, hospitality, seafood, agriculture) entirely unrelated to the candidate's international relations and policy research background. No relevant skills or field overlap.

jobs.title: Senior Designer - Brand & Ideas
jobs.reason: This is a senior creative/design role requiring expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, typography and brand design — specialist skills the candidate does not have. The field (B2B brand design) is unrelated to IR/policy/intelligence, and the senior level requires substantial prior design studio experience.

jobs.title: General Machinery Compliance Coordinator (AD.09.4)
jobs.reason: This is a facilities/occupational health and safety compliance role requiring a National Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and hands-on experience with OHS regulations, fire safety systems, and machinery inspection — entirely unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy background. The required technical engineering qualification is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Assistant Accountant
jobs.reason: Although Sibylline is a core target firm, this is a finance/accounting role requiring part-qualification in AAT, CIMA, or ACCA — a hard ineligibility trigger. The candidate has no bookkeeping or accounts payable/receivable background and no accountancy qualification.
